invariants.rationale: The method expects dedupedRecords to be non-null as it will be passed into HoodieListData.eager.
The method assumes a valid HoodieEngineContext to perform tagging and indexing operations.
A non-null table is necessary for calling table.getIndex() and tagLocation.
dedupedRecords is explicitly typed as List<HoodieRecord<T>>.
table is explicitly typed as HoodieTable<T, List<HoodieRecord<T>>, List<HoodieKey>, List<WriteStatus>>.
